waivers.verdict: Add Daniel Jones for $0 now; drop Lamar Jackson to make room. Jackson's own ankle has him Out, so Jones replaces exactly the insurance Jackson can no longer provide — and with Stefon Diggs' hamstring also turning Out today, Jakobi Meyers has to stay on the roster to start this week instead of being the drop.

lineup.verdict: Start Jakobi Meyers at WR in place of Stefon Diggs. Diggs' hamstring just turned Out, and with Tetairoa McMillan on bye this week, Meyers is the only other healthy receiver on the roster.

trades.verdict: Still send Kirk Cousins for Alvin Kamara to amandaberry — he remains their active FLEX starter off a two-touchdown game, Questionable tag and all. Stefon Diggs' hamstring turning Out today doesn't change this deal; the SUPER_FLEX fallback it needs is today's waiver add of Daniel Jones, not Lamar Jackson, whose own ankle is also Out now.

inactives.verdict: No games imminent — Thursday's Buccaneers-Cowboys game already finished clean, and Sunday's full slate is still two days out with no official inactive lists yet. Stefon Diggs' hamstring turned Out today, but the bench pivot (Jakobi Meyers in at WR) is already queued on today's lineup report, so there's nothing new to decide here.
